newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh plans to set up national stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh plans to set up national stock exchange.

text.p: Bangladesh on Monday decided to set up national stock exchange (NSE), the official BSS news agency said.

"The cabinet today approved in principle the proposal for establishing a national stock exchange," BSS said quoting an official statement. Finance ministry officials said the government was considering setting up the NSE in response to growing interest from thousands of retail investors across the country.
"We are going to set up a national stock exchange in order to rectify some of the deficiencies of the stock exchange," one official said. The country has two stock exchanges -- Dhaka and Chittagong.
